Start here

Drag both apps to Applications, then open Voxt Connector. The same guide runs inside it and ticks off each step.

  1. 2

    Allow Accessibility on the MacOptional

    Phone dictation does not need it.

  2. 3

    Turn on the Local API

    Voxt Connector reaches Voxt through it, on this Mac only.

  3. 4

    Always allow Voxt Connector

    Voxt Connector then connects by itself next time.

  4. 5

    Choose a speech and text model

    They run on this Mac and download once.

  5. 6

    Click Add iPhone

    Each code adds one iPhone and expires in two minutes.

  6. 7

    Install Voxt on your iPhone

    Open this link on your iPhone. Then, in Voxt, scan the code from step 6.

    testflight.apple.com/join/ddn8Mz84
  7. 8

    Dictate in any app

    Switch to the Voxt keyboard and tap the mic.
